defects.title: Downstream go-nostr notification publisher cannot compile against migrated RelayPool.Publish signature
defects.observed_behavior: go test ./internal/controlplane fails because internal/notifications/nostr_dm.go creates a github.com/nbd-wtf/go-nostr.Event and passes it to RelayPool.Publish, which now accepts fiatjaf.com/nostr.Event.
defects.intended_behavior: Downstream protocol consumers should use fiatjaf.com/nostr event/signing/encryption APIs or a deliberate compatibility boundary in their own migration slice.
defects.scope_decision: Not fixed in Item 1 because notifications/controlplane protocol consumers are part of the broader Item 2/3 sweep.
